blocks.heading: Expired hidden
blocks.text: Expired documents without legal hold must be hidden from retrieval after expiration.

blocks.heading: Delete pending
blocks.text: Expired bindings move to DELETE_PENDING before Qdrant deletion.

blocks.heading: Projection delete
blocks.text: Qdrant delete removes the expired point after database fencing succeeds.

blocks.heading: Retry
blocks.text: Failed delete attempts remain retryable before permanent failure.

blocks.heading: Report
blocks.text: Quality Bench marks expired non-held contexts as forbidden when runtime TTL simulation is enabled.

blocks.heading: Legal hold priority
blocks.text: A legal hold prevents TTL cleanup from deleting protected documents even when expiration time has passed.

blocks.heading: Hold reason
blocks.text: A hold record must preserve the reason and owner for audit review.

blocks.heading: Reconciliation skip
blocks.text: Reconciliation skips legal hold points during orphan cleanup.

blocks.heading: Visibility
blocks.text: Held documents remain visible only to callers with sufficient access.

blocks.heading: Release
blocks.text: After hold release, normal TTL cleanup may resume.

blocks.heading: Permanent failure
blocks.text: DELETE_PERMANENTLY_FAILED is used when repeated Qdrant delete attempts exceed the configured retry limit.

blocks.heading: Operator action
blocks.text: Operators must inspect the last delete error stage before replaying deletion.

blocks.heading: Safety
blocks.text: Permanent failure should not purge PostgreSQL bindings before repair.

blocks.heading: Metric
blocks.text: Permanent delete failures must be visible in TTL dashboards.

blocks.heading: Report
blocks.text: Quality Bench consistency metrics include dead-letter and missing point counts.

blocks.heading: Purge precondition
blocks.text: Retention purge must not remove bindings while live outbox events still exist.

blocks.heading: Foreign keys
blocks.text: Purge order must avoid foreign-key violations between chunks, bindings and outbox records.

blocks.heading: Audit
blocks.text: Purge should leave aggregate audit counters for deleted objects.

blocks.heading: Safety
blocks.text: Legal hold documents are never purged by ordinary retention cleanup.

blocks.heading: Verification
blocks.text: Operators verify purge safety by checking live outbox rows and deleted bindings.

blocks.heading: Soft delete
blocks.text: Soft-deleted documents must not be returned by RetrieveContext even if Qdrant still has an old point.

blocks.heading: Final recheck
blocks.text: The PostgreSQL final visibility recheck blocks stale Qdrant points from reaching callers.

blocks.heading: Orphan repair
blocks.text: Reconciliation removes stale Qdrant points without active PostgreSQL bindings.

blocks.heading: Zone safety
blocks.text: Soft delete visibility must remain scoped to the caller access zone.

blocks.heading: Quality case
blocks.text: Quality Bench treats stale soft-deleted contexts as forbidden leakage.
